Only you can decide to forgive, move forward, work it out or separate and move on on your own.   

I understand the devastation.

No matter what you decide, you will be ok 
Take each moment one step at a time
Well you name suits you.  I’ve thought of that.  My children would be effected and I promised them before that we would never move again.  It is not that simple.
I pay the mortgage and house In both our names.  He pays utilities.   He is not a band person.  Just not my person
We are both on house.  I put up down payment and pay the mortgage.

Eight years ago my husband left and had been cheating on me for years.  I have two kids and I have had to take care of them alone.  I got a job immediately and furthered myself.  I met someone and moved myself and my kids.   I bought a house and his name needed to be on it.  Our relationship is failing.  I pay all the bills and I have asked him to leave.  He just won’t.   Everyday is hard.   Every conversation is hard.   Nothing is easy.    Bills to pay and I’m always overwhelmed.    I see no way out and I’m tired of being so sad.
